scope: One private Smarter Justice professional account, firm, seat, billing, and profile-management layer distributing approved specialty records to independent legal micro-portals.
rules: One private Smarter Justice professional account across qualifying legal portals.
Attorneys may claim an existing record or create a private profile from scratch; owner-assisted entry is also supported.
One firm organization account manages offices, professional seats, central billing, and permissions.
Public professional and firm profiles belong on the relevant focused legal micro-portals, not in a duplicate Smarter Justice directory.
Individual evidence, credential verification, owner approval, and portal assignment approval are required before portal publication.
Payment never buys verification, specialty evidence, portal approval, publication, ranking, inquiries, clients, or outcomes.
Corrections, disputes, suppression, and removal never require payment.
Portal exports are versioned, read-only, nonconfidential, and contain no user matters, credentials, payment data, or automatic write instructions.
Dedicated portals remain authoritative for specialty rendering, safeguards, deployment, and public user experience.
